topics.title: Rolle's Theorem
topics.sourceText: If f(x) is continuous on [a,b], differentiable on (a,b), and f(a) = f(b), then there exists at least one c in (a,b) such that f'(c) = 0. A smooth curve that returns to the same height must have a horizontal tangent somewhere in between.

topics.title: Cauchy's Mean Value Theorem
topics.sourceText: If f(x) and g(x) are continuous on [a,b], differentiable on (a,b), and g'(x) != 0 on (a,b), there exists c in (a,b) such that [f(b)-f(a)] / [g(b)-g(a)] = f'(c) / g'(c). It is the ratio form of Lagrange's theorem for two functions.
